name: Kraken
description: A legendary sea monster of enormous size from Scandinavian folklore, traditionally described as a giant cephalopod dwelling off the coasts of Norway and Greenland, capable of dragging entire ships beneath the waves.

aliases.name: Hafgufa
aliases.meaning: Sea reeker; a medieval sea monster often equated with the Kraken

aliases.name: Sciu-crak
aliases.meaning: Variant name recorded by Francesco Negri in 1700

aliases.name: Krake
aliases.meaning: Indefinite form of the Norwegian word from which Kraken derives

regions: Waters off the coast of Nordland, Norway
origin: Legendary range centered on the Norwegian Sea off the coast of Norway, extending to Greenland, Iceland, and in some accounts as far as the waters off Baffin Island, Canada.
